articles.title: Posco workers vote down a wage deal, sending pay talks back to the table
articles.easyKo: 포스코 노조 조합원들이 회사와 합의한 잠정 임금안을 투표로 부결시켰어요. 반대가 51.69%였고, 노조는 재협상을 준비해야 한다고 해요.

paragraphs.en: Union members at the South Korean steelmaker Posco voted down a tentative wage deal on Saturday. According to the union, 51.69 percent of voters were against it, while 48.31 percent approved. The result leaves months of pay talks in a stalemate. The vote was close, with the no side winning by a small margin. The Posco union belongs to the Federation of Korean Metalworkers' Unions.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 철강 회사 포스코의 노조 조합원들이 토요일 잠정 임금 합의안을 투표로 부결시켰어요. 노조에 따르면 투표자의 51.69%가 반대했고 48.31%가 찬성했어요. 이 결과로 몇 달째 이어진 임금 협상이 교착 상태에 빠졌어요. 투표는 박빙이어서 반대쪽이 작은 차이로 이겼어요. 포스코 노조는 금속노련에 속해 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Management and the union had reached the deal on Oct. 30 after a series of intense talks. They began wage talks on June 16 and held about 30 rounds of bargaining. The talks had stalled over key pay terms, including bonuses. The union also staged two partial strikes in September to demand higher pay and bonuses. With a third walkout threatened, the two sides made a last-minute deal.
paragraphs.ko: 회사와 노조는 치열한 협상 끝에 10월 30일 이 안에 합의했어요. 두 쪽은 6월 16일 임금 협상을 시작해 약 30차례 교섭을 했어요. 협상은 보너스를 포함한 핵심 보수 조건을 두고 막혀 있었어요. 노조는 더 높은 임금과 보너스를 요구하며 9월에 부분 파업도 두 번 벌였어요. 세 번째 파업이 예고되자 두 쪽은 막판에 합의했어요.

paragraphs.en: The deal included a 2.6 percent rise in base pay and a one-time bonus of 6 million won. It also offered a three-step promotion increase and higher holiday bonuses. Holiday bonuses were set at 2 million won plus 20 percent of base pay, rising to 30 percent in 2028. Allowances for shift work, residency and maintenance were to rise, and medical coverage was to grow.

The company said it wants a settlement based on labor-management co-prosperity. It will weigh both business conditions and employee feelings to reach a deal that works for both sides. paragraphs.en: US employers added 165,000 jobs in October, far more than experts expected. Economists polled by FactSet had predicted only 65,000 new jobs. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1 percent from 4.2 percent. Hiring came in much hotter than expected.

articles.title: Qantas will raise fares and trim flights as fuel costs jump
articles.easyKo: 호주 항공사 콴타스가 연료비가 10억 달러 넘게 뛰어 항공 요금을 올리고 국내선을 줄이겠다고 했어요. 중동 분쟁이 2월에 시작된 뒤 연료 값이 올랐어요.

paragraphs.en: Australian airline Qantas says it will raise airfares and trim some domestic flights. The reason is fuel, as its costs have jumped by more than $1 billion. The airline gave the news in an update to investors before its annual general meeting.
paragraphs.ko: 호주 항공사 콴타스는 항공 요금을 올리고 국내선 일부를 줄이겠다고 말해요. 이유는 연료예요. 연료비가 10억 달러 넘게 뛰었어요. 항공사는 주주총회를 앞두고 투자자에게 보낸 설명 자료에서 이 소식을 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: Fuel prices rose after the conflict in the Middle East began in February. Qantas now expects its fuel bill for the last six months of 2026 to be $3.75 billion. That is $1.1 billion higher than a year earlier.
paragraphs.ko: 중동 분쟁이 2월에 시작된 뒤 연료 값이 올랐어요. 콴타스는 2026년 하반기 6개월 연료비가 37억 5천만 달러가 될 것으로 봐요. 1년 전보다 11억 달러 많은 금액이에요.

paragraphs.en: A new lawsuit says the US government is refusing to cancel some student loans. The loans belong to students whose colleges closed suddenly. paragraphs.en: Two older showers also appear this month. The Southern Taurids peak around Nov. 5 and the Northern Taurids around Nov. 12. Each makes only about five meteors an hour, but they can produce very bright fireballs.

Voyager 1 is also reaching a distance of one light-day from Earth, and NASA will mark it on Nov. 17. A full supermoon follows on Nov. 24, the start of three supermoons in a row.
